items.title: Apex Group appoints Maqbool Mohamed as global head of real assets
items.snippet: Apex Group Ltd. (“Apex Group”), a global financial services provider servicing more than $3.5 trillion in assets, has appointed Maqbool Mohamed as Global Head of Real Assets. Maqbool will work across the Group’s businesses to bring the full breadth of its technology-enabled platform to real estate clients and strengthen service delivery across the investment lifecycle.
